Hi all,

Finance notes: we can invoice Novamed EU BV from our EU entity (Redwood Inference Europe B.V.) provided we receive valid VAT evidence for the EU entity. Operational details:

- Required docs: copy of EU VAT registration (VAT ID / VIES check screenshot preferred) and the PO number. If we receive the VAT cert, we can process the invoice under reverse charge (no local VAT applied). If not, well need to charge VAT and re-invoice if evidence is provided later.
- Invoice recipient and remit-to: please confirm the exact remit email (we prefer accounting@novamed.eu or ap-eu@novamed.com).
- Net terms: our standard is Net 30. We can offer Net 45 for this deal subject to a quick credit check; Net 45 will require Finance approval and may be subject to a late-payment fee schedule (we can document that in the Order Form notes).

Karthik: if Sales Ops can produce a redline of the Order Form showing the payer entity as Novamed EU BV and an invoice routing block, Finance can confirm the signature party and invoice header text. Kimberly: if an MSA amendment is required wed prefer a narrow amendment limited to the billing entity — please advise.

Related: HubSpot deal record — https://app.hubspot.com/deal/23109/DEAL-10934
Internal playbook: https://redwood-internal.sharepoint.com/sites/finance/invoice-routing-playbook.pdf
